# Project workflow

- [x] Clarify project requirements: Python 3.11+, Gymnasium, Robots Evolved mechanics.
- [x] Scaffold the package under `src/robotsevolved_env`.
- [x] No additional VS Code extensions are required.
- [x] Run diagnostics and tests after implementation.

Keep all runtime and agent environments offline. The website is only a source for manual rule research and separately curated static snapshots. Never automate score or leaderboard submission.
